verdict.line: You win if you land E (Apprehend) into R (Noxian Guillotine) before she can Riposte, and lose if you let repeated auto trades stack her Duelist healing.

brief.thesis: Darius sits at 51.2% over 3,130 games here with clear lane and solo-kill advantage, because Decimate (Q) and the Apprehend (E) armor shred let him stack Hemorrhage to 5 faster than Fiora can out-heal it before level 6. That edge compresses to even by mid-game once Fiora's Duelist stacks and Burst of Speed (E) kiting let her win extended autoattack exchanges, and it can be erased in one trade if she parries your execute with Riposte (W).

theirWindow.what: She can bait a R or W (Crippling Strike) auto onto her parry and reflect magic damage back for free. Don't commit a bare R while her W is live; wait for her to burn it on a minion or let the cooldown (10/9/8/7/6s) tick down first.

yourWindow.what: Lunge can dash twice within a couple seconds at no cost, but once both are gone she has no gap-closer or escape for 16-8s. Pull her with E (Apprehend) immediately and chain straight into R so Riposte can't react — the E-into-R combo, not a standalone R, is how you dodge the parry.

start.why: Picked in 77.6% of games at 52% win rate; the extra damage and sustain win the early auto trades you need to stack Hemorrhage before her Duelist healing ramps up.

boots.why: 81.7% pick rate at 51% win rate; flattens the physical damage from her Lunge pokes and basic-attack trades that Duelist is built to punish.

core.why: Highest-winrate core path (62.4% over 343 games); the active haste closes the gap on her Lunge dashes so she can't just kite out your E range.
Move speed stacking lets you stick through her Burst of Speed window instead of losing the foot race after she disengages.
Completes the top-winrate build; the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through her Blade Waltz burst once she's 6.

situational.when: her Duelist healing is winning extended trades
she's all-inning you with Lunge plus Blade Waltz and you need to survive the burst
you want a hard slow on-hit instead of Youmuu's haste to lock her in E range
her team shifts toward magic damage and plain physical armor stops being enough

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-winrate page here (52.7%, 20.9% pick); the adaptive force ramps during the same prolonged bleed trades Hemorrhage is built for, directly offsetting her Duelist sustain in a drawn-out fight.

summoners.why: Highest-winrate combo run in this matchup (51.9%, 34.1% pick); Ignite's grievous wounds directly cuts into the Duelist healing that otherwise lets Fiora win extended trades, and Flash covers the gap if your E (Apprehend) pull is on cooldown.

playing.title: Punish with E at level 2
playing.detail: Apprehend is live before her kit is fully online; pull her into auto range before she has a second Lunge charge to disengage with.

playing.title: Stack five Hemorrhage before R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales per stack, so land Q (Decimate) and autos to max stacks before committing the execute rather than opening with it.

playing.title: Never open with a bare R
playing.detail: If Riposte (W) is up she can parry it and reflect magic damage for free; pull with E first and follow immediately with R so she has no window to react.

playing.title: Count her Lunge charges
playing.detail: Q has a free second cast within a couple seconds; once both are spent she has no mobility for 16-8 seconds depending on rank, which is your window to all-in.

playing.title: Don't extend auto trades
playing.detail: Duelist stacks every time she hits you and heals her over time; burst her down with Q, W (Crippling Strike) slow, and R instead of trading autos back and forth.

playing.title: Spread out once she hits 6
playing.detail: Blade Waltz strikes nearby enemy champions with diminishing damage on repeat hits, so don't group tightly with your support or jungler in skirmishes.

playing.title: Buy Bramble Vest if trades stall
playing.detail: If she's consistently outlasting your bleed damage with Duelist healing, the grievous wounds component is the direct counter.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from current-patch games; the mechanical reasoning (E-into-R timing, Hemorrhage stacking, Riposte interaction) is this brief's own tactical read, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Fiora’s (P) when fighting her. Do not let her block your ultimate with her (W) by using [E] - [R] combo instead.
